title: Antimicrobial-resistant bacteria in wastewater-irrigated Mexican soils and transfer of resistant bacteria from irrigated soils to cilantro plants
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6VA00055J, Paper

Dipen Pulami, Deeksha Bhati, Sara Gallego, Kornelia Smalla, Kathia Lüneberg, Christina Siebe, Benjamin J Heyde, Jan Siemens, Stefanie P. Glaeser
Transition from irrigation with untreated wastewater to WWTP effluent did not reduce cultivable RB in soils long-term irrigated with untreated wastewater. Regular monitoring of fresh produce for RB during the irrigation transition is advised.
